seo.title: 36 Essential Tools for Smart Contract Auditors
seo.description: A curated list of tools for smart contract auditors covering static analysis, fuzzing, formal verification, and audit workflow management.

content.intro: Smart contract auditing requires a detailed toolkit spanning automated analysis, manual review aids, and workflow management. Here are the essential tools used by professional auditors.

sections.heading: Static Analysis
sections.description: Tools that analyze code without executing it.

items.name: Slither
items.description: The industry standard static analyzer from Trail of Bits. 80+ detectors covering common vulnerabilities, code quality, and optimization.

items.name: Aderyn
items.description: Rust-based static analyzer from Cyfrin. Fast analysis with growing detector library.

items.name: Solhint
items.description: Solidity linter for style and security. Catches common issues early.

items.name: Semgrep
items.description: Pattern-based code analysis. Write custom rules for project-specific issues.

items.name: Amarna
items.description: Static analyzer for Cairo/StarkNet contracts. Check the GitHub repo for documentation and examples.

sections.heading: Symbolic Execution
sections.description: Tools that explore all possible program paths mathematically.

items.name: Mythril
items.description: Symbolic execution for detecting security vulnerabilities through constraint solving.

items.name: Halmos
items.description: Symbolic testing tool from a16z. Proves properties through symbolic execution.

items.name: HEVM
items.description: Symbolic execution engine from DappTools. Deep analysis of EVM bytecode.

items.name: Pyrometer
items.description: Abstract interpretation for finding numeric issues like overflows.

items.name: Manticore
items.description: Symbolic execution engine supporting EVM and native binaries.

sections.heading: Fuzzing
sections.description: Tools that test contracts with random inputs to find edge cases.

items.name: Echidna
items.description: Property-based fuzzer from Trail of Bits. Tests invariants through random input generation.

items.name: Foundry Fuzz
items.description: Fast fuzzing built into Foundry. First-choice for most projects.

items.name: Medusa
items.description: Parallel fuzzer compatible with Echidna tests. Better performance on multi-core systems.

items.name: Chimera
items.description: Framework for building reusable fuzz tests across protocols.

items.name: Harvey
items.description: Greybox fuzzer that uses coverage to guide input generation.

sections.heading: Formal Verification
sections.description: Tools that mathematically prove contract properties.

items.name: Certora Prover
items.description: Commercial formal verification platform. Industry standard for critical protocols.

items.name: Solidity SMTChecker
items.description: Built-in formal verification in Solidity compiler. Free and open-source.

items.name: Act
items.description: Specification language for formal verification of smart contracts.

items.name: K Framework
items.description: Formal semantics framework. Used for EVM formal semantics. Free and open-source.

items.name: Tenderly
items.description: Transaction simulation and debugging. Trace transactions step by step.

items.name: Foundry Debugger
items.description: Interactive debugger for stepping through transactions. Free and open-source.

items.name: Etherscan
items.description: Block explorer with verified source code, transaction traces, and decompilation.

items.name: Phalcon
items.description: Transaction explorer from BlockSec showing detailed execution traces.

items.name: Dedaub
items.description: Decompiler and contract analysis. See contract logic without source.

sections.heading: Code Review
sections.description: Tools that aid manual code review.

items.name: VS Code Solidity
items.description: Essential VS Code extension with syntax highlighting and IntelliSense.

items.name: Solidity Visual Developer
items.description: VS Code extension with interactive graphs, metrics, and call trees.

items.name: Sol2UML
items.description: Generate UML diagrams from Solidity contracts. Check the GitHub repo for documentation and examples.

items.name: Surya
items.description: Utility for contract analysis including call graphs and function summaries.

sections.heading: Audit Workflow
sections.description: Tools for managing the audit process.

items.name: Code4rena
items.description: Competitive audit platform. Participate in audits or submit protocols.

items.name: Sherlock
items.description: Audit marketplace with insurance component. Used by production teams across the ecosystem.

items.name: Immunefi
items.description: Bug bounty platform for Web3. Find vulnerabilities for rewards.

items.name: Notion/Obsidian
items.description: Note-taking tools for organizing findings and audit documentation.

sections.heading: Reference and Research
sections.description: Resources for staying current and learning.

items.name: SWC Registry
items.description: Smart Contract Weakness Classification. Standard vulnerability taxonomy.

items.name: Rekt News
items.description: Post-mortems of DeFi hacks. Essential reading for auditors. Free and open-source.

items.name: DeFiHackLabs
items.description: Repository of exploit reproductions. Learn attack patterns hands-on.

items.name: Solodit
items.description: Database of audit findings from public reports. Free and open-source.

proTips.tip: Run Slither first on every audit. It catches low-hanging fruit and gives you a codebase overview.
Combine static analysis with fuzzing. Static tools find code patterns; fuzzers find edge cases.
Reproduce past exploits to understand attack patterns. DeFiHackLabs is invaluable.
Use Tenderly to trace live transactions when investigating suspicious behavior.
Build your own checklist from audit reports. Solodit is a goldmine for this.
